evidence.detail: The class exposes one static JButton factory for LoadoutsPanel, loading clone.png, setting visible label 'Clone', and installing rs/gui/b/a/b as its sole ActionListener.
The exact tooltip states that Clone takes the items currently equipped in game and sets them as the current active loadout.
The factory accepts only R390 LoadoutsPanel and creates no independent state or unrelated controls.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 factory role for the Clone button in the loadout panel.

evidence.detail: The class is constructed only by CloneLoadoutButtonFactory and holds the owning LoadoutsPanel.
On action it requires an active LoadoutDefinition, then creates a small JFrame tied to that loadout name with exact Yes/No buttons.
Yes installs rs/gui/b/a/c and No installs rs/gui/b/a/d, separating commit and cancel behavior without performing the clone itself.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 action that opens the Clone confirmation UI for the active loadout.

evidence.detail: The Yes action clears the active LoadoutDefinition's stored item maps/arrays, reads the live client inventory/equipment widget item arrays, and repopulates the loadout entries with item ids and quantities.
The same action captures current spellbook, prayer book, and seven skill-level values into the active LoadoutDefinition rather than cloning equipment alone.

After successful capture it refreshes the LoadoutManager/panel views and closes the confirmation window; when the client character is unavailable it shows the exact not-logged-in guidance dialog instead.
The action also emits the exact ::cldt client command used by the clone flow after refreshing the local loadout state.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the clone commit action; 'CharacterState' reflects the proven inventory/equipment + spellbook + prayer + skill capture surface.

evidence.detail: The No-button ActionListener only hides and disposes the clone confirmation JFrame.
It is constructed exclusively by OpenCloneLoadoutConfirmationAction as the confirmation dialog's No action.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 cancel action for the Clone loadout confirmation dialog.

evidence.detail: The listener holds only R392 LoadoutMetadataEditorDialog and is created as part of that dialog's action surface.
actionPerformed does exactly two operations on the metadata editor: setVisible(false) and dispose(). No loadout mutation or unrelated state is touched.
